text:
Maria_support: FYI Acme reported a spike of 502s for hosted /v1/generate during long-lived streaming sessions, started ~2026-03-15T18:03:41Z. Partial chunks then connection closed. Customer sees many client-side retries causing duplicate outputs. Can someone triage?

AcmeApp (customer): seeing ~8-12% of streaming requests fail w/ 502s. Happens when session lasts >30s, usually after ~4-8 tokens streamed. Not seeing auth errors. SDK retry settings are default. We can reproduce consistently with our integration tests.

sam_sre: thanks — can you paste a raw request/response trace (no secrets)? headers, body size, and whether you're using SSE or chunked streaming.

AcmeApp (customer): using chunked transfer (node sdk streaming). Header snippet:

```
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Content-Type: application/json
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
X-Client-Session: acme-123
```

Response when it fails:

```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 18:05:03 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 67

{"error":"upstream prematurely closed connection while streaming"}
```

maria_support: that's helpful. Sam, Kai - any known infra change that could cause upstream sockets to close on long chunked streams?

deploy-bot: [notice] nginx/stream-proxy redeployed to region-us-west-2 at 2026-03-15T17:58:10Z (deploy 2026.03.15-1187)

kai_eng: I saw that deploy. The change touched proxy keepalive and buffer tuning. Could be related. Sam, can we confirm logs from the tenant-pool for acme-123 around ts 1771064330-1771064500?

sam_sre: pulling logs, one minute. Preliminary: a few upstream connections to model-worker returned 502 with error "connection reset by peer" and model-worker logs show abrupt process-level socket close. Full dump attached.

sam_sre: log excerpt:

```
[2026-03-15T18:05:02Z] upstream=model-worker-5: read: connection reset by peer, client=10.34.2.8, req_id=abc123
[2026-03-15T18:05:02Z] stream-session acme-123: sent 4 chunks, then closed
[2026-03-15T18:05:03Z] proxy: upstream returned 502 to gateway
```

kai_eng: interesting — model-worker process hit an internal keepalive timeout, then the runtime's socket closed. Could be that the proxy started sending FIN while worker still had socket open during long tail. Also possible backpressure / event-loop stall in worker when many small chunks arrive.

maria_support: Acme — can you run a focused repro using curl against the hosted endpoint (no SDK) and paste the exact command you used? We want to verify SDK isn't reordering or reusing sockets.

AcmeApp (customer): here's a reproducible curl test we run from k8s pod:

```
curl -v -X POST "https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-3x","input":"long prompt...","stream":true}' --no-buffer
```

That returns 502 reliably within ~10-40s when we pump repeated short chunks via the SDK. With the plain curl single-shot stream it's flaky but still reproducible.

kai_eng: thanks. Repro steps we want customer to try (and we did internally):
1) Run curl with --no-buffer to force chunked streaming.
2) Add header `Connection: close` to see if proxy-to-worker keepalive is implicated.
3) Run `curl --http1.1` to ensure no HTTP/2 multiplexing differences.

Addendum: create an idempotency key header `X-Idempotency-Key` for client-side retry dedupe while we investigate.

maria_support: Sam/Kai, immediate mitigation options?

sam_sre: short-term - we can roll back the proxy keepalive change in us-west-2 or selectively increase worker socket timeouts. I'll open a rollback PR to 2026.03.15-1187 and apply to affected clusters. Also will add a temporary retry-limiter at gateway to prevent tight client retry loops amplifying error rates.

kai_eng: long-term - make worker runtime more robust to partial-close events; add graceful draining logic for streaming sessions and incrementally increase upstream read timeout. Also add per-session backpressure metrics to detect small-chunk storms.

maria_support: messaging plan for customer?

noor_csm: I'll tell Acme that we have identified a recent proxy tune as likely cause, that we have a rollback in flight (ETA ~20m), and a short-term mitigation to reduce retries. We recommend they add idempotency keys and set SDK retry limit to 1 for now. Draft:

"We're seeing an interaction between a recent proxy tuning and long-lived chunked streaming that can cause upstream sockets to close, leading to 502s. We're rolling back the change and adding a retry-limiter; you can also mitigate by adding an idempotency header and lowering SDK retries. We'll update this thread as soon as rollback completes."

AcmeApp (customer): thanks — we can add idempotency and drop retries. Please let us know when rollback is done so we can re-run tests.

deploy-bot: [action] rollback PR 2026.03.15-1187 created and approved; rolling back region-us-west-2 now.

sam_sre: rollback started at 18:22:10Z, monitoring logs for error rate.

sam_sre: update — error rate for acme tenant dropped from 8% to 0.7% within 5 minutes of rollback. Probing shows no 502s on the earlier repro curl after 18:28Z.

kai_eng: root cause analysis next steps: reproduce locally with proxy tune enabled, add regression test in CI to exercise long chunked streams, and add a runtime fix for streaming keepalive handling. I'll own the ticket.

maria_support: Acme — confirmed rollback reduced errors. Can you validate on your side and re-run the test? We'll keep this thread open until you confirm.

AcmeApp (customer): re-ran tests at 18:32Z — looks good, no 502s in 100 runs. Thanks for the quick response, appreciate the transparency :thumbsup:

noor_csm: I'll send a postmortem and an account note. Kai, Sam — please add mitigation steps to the public status page and pick a timeline for the durable fix.

kai_eng: will do. Planned work: CI regression by 2026-03-22, runtime patch by 2026-04-05. I'll post updates here.

maria_support: closing loop with Acme in 24h unless they see recurrence. Good job team.

sam_sre: adding tag incident/502-streaming-spike and linking infra PRs.

AcmeApp (customer): thanks everyone. We'll keep an eye and reach out if anything else pops up.
